problem: Preparing capture cleared all confirmed boundary frames. Returning to active B after save then depended on another paused seek, which timed out if no new frame callback arrived.
scopeOfRootCause: Confirmed unnecessary cache invalidation and reproduced the resulting timeout under controlled missing-frame delivery. The original browser-internal reason for not delivering a new frame was not captured and is not asserted.
change: Forced positioning invalidates only the requested frame. Capture still really seeks A; confirmed B remains reusable while source/signature validity checks, frame confirmation, cache limits and cancellation remain in force.

baseline.exactTimeout: 还没等到目标画面，请检查网络后重试。
baseline.otherFailure: Repeated terminal notifications required a fresh boundary decode rather than reusing the confirmed frame

covers: Confirmed B restores without another seek when no new decoder frame arrives
Repeated release notifications do not start a new boundary decode
A cached A frame cannot bypass the actual seek back to the capture start
Source identity change prevents restoration from the old source
Resolution change invalidates cached frames and requires a new confirmed frame

ownedEdgeControl.scenario: Confirm B, execute production capture preparation, drive owned playback to B, pause, wait one second, suppress new frame callbacks during production capture-hook release
ownedEdgeControl.baselineResult: 恢复失败：Error: 还没等到目标画面，请检查网络后重试。
ownedEdgeControl.fixedResult: 恢复通过：B=8.000 秒，画面 8.000 秒，复用缓存，新增取帧请求 0 次
ownedEdgeControl.replay: Run tools/run-video-preview-lab.mjs with the documented FFmpeg environment; enter selection, set A=2/B=8, confirm B, then click 检查保存后预览恢复
ownedEdgeControl.scope: Real browser decoding and production selection/capture-release code with explicit missing-frame fault injection; no actual tabCapture, encode, upload or native save
ownedEdgeControl.probeLocation: apps/extension/src/video/lab-recovery.ts (lab import only, not included in formal content script)

formalPostSaveRetest.trigger: After preparation of A=2/B=8, user followed the one-shortcut automatic-save instruction and replied 好了. No synthetic recording shortcut was sent by the agent.
formalPostSaveRetest.earlierAbnormalReply: User explicitly corrected the accidental 出现了异常 choice and said the test had not been run. It is not counted as a failed recording.
formalPostSaveRetest.visualReview: Actual saved frames 0, 90 and 183 show progressing source content with no selection window, pet, native control bar or end-screen recommendation overlay. Webpage captions remain; their semantics and frame-exact alignment were not assessed.
formalPostSaveRetest.scope: One real YouTube automatic-stop MP4 save with an already confirmed B frame; confirms post-save preview recovery on the loaded fix. Earlier timing/close-mode checks were not repeated.

limitations: Controlled missing-frame delivery reproduces the failure mechanism, not the original browser-internal trigger
A missing or invalid boundary cache still requires a genuinely confirmed new frame; network/media errors are not hidden
The formal post-save retest passes this specific YouTube sample and is not a complete multi-site quality matrix
Existing recording-duration acceptance is preserved and was not repeated in this investigation
Original short-clip freeze, full video quality matrix and installation acceptance are separate open work
